suites.title: Affordance fixtures (SYNTHETIC)
suites.description: Schema 1.1 fixtures for the 3D viewer (parts, anchors, sidecar joints, look-ahead). Never real data.

cases.title: Sit: chair to armchair (SYNTHETIC)
cases.rule: Pelvis anchor on a Sittable part: the receiver anchor proposal lands on the armchair seat plane (z 0.42). Display IK figure, no joints.

cases.title: Write: wall whiteboard to standing easel (SYNTHETIC)
cases.rule: Hand anchor on a vertical Drawable part: the receiver hand proposal follows the mapped stroke on the easel board plane. MotionGen-style joints come from a sidecar.

cases.title: Look-ahead buffer (SYNTHETIC)
cases.rule: A MotionGen-style sidecar carries the played joints and a look-ahead joints channel (buffer_revision, horizon): the not-yet-played buffer is drawn as a translucent ghost.

cases.title: Furniture gallery (SYNTHETIC)
cases.rule: One element per procedural builder (chair, armchair, stool, bench, sofa, office chair, table, desk, counter, shelf, whiteboard, blackboard, easel, flip chart, panel, fallback).
